_comment: Window order rules (designer decision 2026-11-23). Read by WindowOrderRules (C++, Source/CodexTactics/Public/Interactables/WindowOrderRules.h). A WHOLE (shut) window is loud to climb (glass, 15 m noise) and opens only per these rules; a BROKEN window is an ordinary quiet vault for every path. 1 = on, 0 = off.
_solo_group_combat_windows: Rule 1: Solo with the squad box-selected, IN A FIGHT (wave / firefight / enemies hunting the squad): every move order opens the windows on the way - the men never get stuck, the noise no longer matters.
_solo_group_whole_squad_only: Rule 1 needs the WHOLE squad selected (0: any box selection of 2+ men).
_solo_run_in_fight_windows: Solo: a run order (double click) in a fight opens the windows (the 2026-11-22 'run in a fight' rule).
_formation_run_in_fight_windows: Rule 2: the formation never takes a whole window on its own - a run in a fight opens none (1 = the 2026-11-22 behaviour).
_formation_follow_broken_only: Rule 2: on the leader's window order the followers go through only once he has broken it (0: they may take the whole window too).
_approach_past_cm: G024: the climb-in walks to this many centimetres past the face on the operative's own side before the vault. Inside the 125 cm vault probe.
_landing_past_cm: G024: the order's landing, this many centimetres past the face on the far side (the old 120 cm past-face point).
_approach_match_cm: G024: a move whose goal is within this of the landing is that climb (the leader's target is the landing itself).
_approach_arrive_cm: G024: the near face counts as reached when the walk stops within this of the approach point.
